# orq_mcp_gateway (Resource)

An MCP gateway that exposes a curated tool surface of upstream MCP servers to MCP clients. Plugins, served workspace skills, icons, runtime limits and per-link resource exposure are not managed by this resource and are left as configured in orq.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A gateway that exposes the read-only tools of one upstream server to two
# projects. A server can only be linked after its tools were synced once.
resource "orq_mcp_gateway" "support" {
  key          = "support"
  display_name = "Support tools"
  description  = "Tools available to the support agents"
  mode         = "DIRECT"              # CODE | DIRECT
  tool_naming  = "PREFIX_ON_COLLISION" # PREFIX_WITH_SERVER_KEY | PREFIX_ON_COLLISION

  server_links = [
    {
      mcp_server_id = orq_mcp_server.docs.id
      alias         = "docs"
      enabled       = true

      tool_exposure = {
        mode      = "ALL" # ALL | SELECTED | NONE
        read_only = true
      }
    },
  ]

  # Must stay within the sharing of every linked server.
  sharing = {
    project_ids = [orq_project.support.id, orq_project.sales.id]
  }

  guardrails {
    id           = "orq_secret_detection"
    execute_on   = "both" # input | output | both
    is_guardrail = true
  }
}

output "support_gateway_url" {
  value = orq_mcp_gateway.support.public_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `key` (String) Lowercase slug (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores; max 64), unique per workspace. Backs the gateway's public MCP URL. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form note about what this gateway is for.
- `guardrails` (Block List) Guardrails run on the arguments and result of every tool call this gateway serves. Omitting every block removes the gateway's guardrails. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--guardrails))
- `mode` (String) Shape of the tool surface: `CODE` (compact discovery-and-execution surface) or `DIRECT` (each upstream tool exposed directly). Defaults to `CODE`.
- `server_links` (Attributes List) Upstream servers this gateway aggregates; omitted removes every link. A server can only be linked once its tools were synced, and the gateway's `sharing` must stay within each linked server's `sharing`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_links))
- `sharing` (Attributes) Which projects may use this gateway. Exactly one of `all_projects` or `project_ids` must be set. Omitted shares with every project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sharing))
- `tool_naming` (String) How upstream tool names are namespaced: `PREFIX_WITH_SERVER_KEY` or `PREFIX_ON_COLLISION`. Defaults to `PREFIX_ON_COLLISION`.
- `website_url` (String) Website advertised to MCP clients. Omitted advertises the orq documentation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) MCP gateway ID assigned by orq.
- `public_url` (String) Endpoint MCP clients connect to; relative when the deployment has no public base URL configured.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedblock--guardrails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrails`

Required:

- `execute_on` (String) When to run: `input`, `output`, or `both`.
- `id` (String) A built-in guardrail slug (`orq_pii_detection`, `orq_secret_detection`) or the id of a custom evaluator.

Optional:

- `is_guardrail` (Boolean) `true` blocks the tool call on a failing check; `false` only observes.
- `options` (String) Per-guardrail configuration as a JSON object string.
- `sample_rate` (Number) Fraction of tool calls to evaluate (0-1).


<a id="nestedatt--server_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_links`

Required:

- `alias` (String) Prefix used instead of the server key when namespacing this server's tool names. Unique within the gateway.
- `mcp_server_id` (String) ID of the upstream MCP server, e.g. `orq_mcp_server.docs.id`.
- `tool_exposure` (Attributes) Which of the server's tools this gateway exposes. `tool_ids` and `excluded_tool_ids` are only accepted when `mode` is `SELECTED`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_links--tool_exposure))

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this link contributes tools to the gateway. Defaults to `true`.
- `skill_exposure` (Attributes) Which of the server's skills this gateway serves. Omitted serves none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_links--skill_exposure))

<a id="nestedatt--server_links--tool_exposure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_links.tool_exposure`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Selection strategy: `ALL`, `SELECTED` or `NONE`.

Optional:

- `excluded_tool_ids` (List of String) Tool ids deliberately left unexposed when `mode` is `SELECTED`.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Keep only the tools the upstream annotates as read-only. Defaults to `false`.
- `tool_ids` (List of String) Tool ids to expose when `mode` is `SELECTED`. Ids are assigned by orq when the server's tools are synced.


<a id="nestedatt--server_links--skill_exposure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_links.skill_exposure`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Selection strategy: `ALL`, `SELECTED` or `NONE`.

Optional:

- `skill_uris` (List of String) Skill URIs to serve when `mode` is `SELECTED`.



<a id="nestedatt--sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sharing`

Optional:

- `all_projects` (Boolean) Share with every project in the workspace. Only accepts `true`. Mutually exclusive with `project_ids`.
- `project_ids` (List of String) Share with exactly these projects; an empty list shares with no project. Mutually exclusive with `all_projects`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# MCP gateways are imported by their id or their workspace-unique key.
terraform import orq_mcp_gateway.example support
```
